title: Your First Weapon
blurb: Take Hale's issue, learn the three verbs, and open the Armoury.

steps.text: Take Hale's hunter's issue at the High Gate.
steps.hint: Talk to Hale, or to Ilse at the camp if you missed him. You pick Daggers, an Axe or a Maul.

steps.text: Fight with your new weapon: strike, guard and dodge.
steps.hint: Tap to strike, hold right mouse to guard, sprint and tap a direction to dodge.

steps.text: Open the Armoury: sneak and talk to Hale.
steps.hint: It lists every style, what each weapon needs and where each part comes from.
Hale's rack sells every pattern at your rank for essence.
